subject.title: Token Plan catalog curation in #113681 used the Coding Plan endpoint: adds a model that 404s and keeps the oldest of each family

question: Should the Token Plan picker remain a small curated shortlist, and if so which current Token Plan allowlisted models must represent Qwen, Kimi, GLM, and DeepSeek families after removing `qwen3-coder-next`?
rationale: The invalid Coding Plan model can be removed mechanically, but the requested restoration of newer family members changes the intentionally curated visible-picker policy rather than only repairing transport behavior.

options.title: Correct and retain a curated shortlist
options.body: Remove `qwen3-coder-next` and select current Token Plan-specific representatives for each supported family, while keeping supported omitted models usable by exact reference.

options.title: Expose the full documented Token Plan list
options.body: Use Alibaba’s Token Plan exact allowlist as the picker catalog and rely on subscription errors or live discovery for tier-specific availability.

options.title: Keep the present shortlist except the invalid row
options.body: Remove only `qwen3-coder-next` and deliberately retain the existing older representatives despite the vendor’s newer documented variants.

recommendation.title: Correct and retain a curated shortlist
recommendation.body: Remove `qwen3-coder-next` and select current Token Plan-specific representatives for each supported family, while keeping supported omitted models usable by exact reference.

likelyOwner.reason: The same history establishes both the curation policy and the direct-reference boundary that this decision must preserve.
